scope: Run each case in a fresh disposable project; these are guest expectations, not claims of device execution.

cases.name: files_and_script
cases.script: mkdir -p work/sub; cd work; NAME='Sucrune'; printf '%s\n' "hello $NAME" > greeting; echo second >> greeting; cp greeting copy; mv copy moved; cat moved; printf '%s\n' 'echo script-ran' 'exit 7' > task.sh; sh task.sh; echo $?; touch empty; rm greeting moved empty; pwd

cases.name: variables_logic_and_quotes
cases.script: A='hello world'; B=$A; echo "$B" '${A}'; false && echo wrong || echo recovered; true || echo wrong && echo done; false; echo $?

cases.name: nested_scope_and_redirection
cases.script: A=outer; sh -c 'A=inner; mkdir child; cd child; echo $A; pwd' > result; cat result; echo $A; pwd

cases.name: unicode_paths
cases.script: mkdir '项目 😀'; cd '项目 😀'; echo '你好，Sucrune' > '结果.txt'; cat '结果.txt'; pwd

cases.name: pipeline_rejected_before_current_command
cases.stderr_contains: pipelines and background commands are unsupported

cases.name: exec_lua_script_replaces_shell
cases.script: printf '%s\n' 'print("from-lua")' > task.lua; exec /bin/lua task.lua; echo unreachable

cases.name: exec_file_streams
cases.script: printf '%s\n' '10' '20' '12' > input; printf '%s\n' 'local n=0;for v in io.lines() do n=n+tonumber(v) end;print(n)' > sum.lua; exec /bin/lua sum.lua < input > result

cases.name: builtin_input_output_restore
cases.script: echo one > input; cat < input > out; echo two >> out; cat out; echo restored

cases.name: failed_exec_restores_stdout
cases.script: exec /missing > out || echo restored; echo alive

cases.name: cancellation
cases.action: Wait for started, cancel through host API, then verify worker death and no second line.
